name: aetheron-core
description: Aetheron Core — autonomous Quant Trading & Signal Backend. MT5 tick feed -> Supabase-persisted candles -> server-side strategy engine (ATR sizing, 50-day Donchian breakout, split exits) -> SSE streams for price data and chat-ops events. Developed by Eng Hasan Mohamad.
